g.text: Actual exporter output uploaded unchanged | #43 does not fix supplier-zero discovery
Original reporter JSON; built exporter 303524d; supplier: jlcpcb. No input metadata or CSV angle edits.
Result: D4's side angle is corrected, but SOT-23 leads still do not align. Eight missing-supplier-metadata warnings.
These are actual JLCPCB 3D captures of CPL-actual-exporter.csv, without the earlier manual +180° calibration.
The reporter JSON has no selected supplier part numbers or supplier pin-1 map. The preparation helper changes nothing.
No manual rotation/translation/auto-alignment in JLCPCB. No order or payment. Separate supplier-data integration is needed.
